column2: 『It eats bugs, so it lures them in』

easier to move in than it looks.

But being stared at like that
I'm not saying it to be kind.
Oil and water, cat and dog,
so just give up and sing.

but I won't really sell it.

so it was in the way?
you must say it was boring.

the view has a calm mood.

if a foul fly comes our way?

so you didn't see the view, then.
